purpose: Describe the bounded professional outcome this body exists to produce.

owns: Define the professional dimensions this body is responsible for.
does_not_own: Name adjacent professional dimensions this body must not absorb.
escalates_when: Escalate when a decision crosses another profession's ownership boundary.

minimum_capabilities: Follow explicit procedures and distinguish evidence from inference.
adaptation_rules: Adapt execution detail to the intelligence without silently changing professional standards.

reads: Canonical project state relevant to this profession.
writes: Bounded proposals, evidence, and handoff packets.
coordination_contracts: Do not overwrite another profession's accepted state without its evidence path.

inputs.description: The bounded professional problem to work on.

outputs.description: A bounded result with evidence, limits, and handoff information.

retrieval_rules: Prefer authoritative and current sources appropriate to the profession.
uncertainty_rules: State uncertainty when required knowledge is missing or conflicting.

canonical: Stable validated professional rules and definitions.
project: Project-specific accepted facts relevant to this profession.
working: Temporary hypotheses and in-progress reasoning aids.
retention_rules: Promote working information only through an explicit evidence-backed transition.

claim_rules: Use the strongest label actually supported; never upgrade evidence by wording.
minimum_for_working: Define profession-specific minimum evidence before status WORKING.

may_decide: Bounded decisions clearly inside this profession's ownership.
must_consult: Cross-profession decisions or changes to shared invariants.
must_not_decide: Claims or changes outside the profession's evidence and ownership boundary.

promotion_requirements: New capability has a professional test or explicit evidence route.
Existing contracts still pass or changed contracts are explicit.
